Below is a list of rituals practiced via '''[[Necromancy (VTM)|Necromancy]]'''.

==Rituals==

===African/Voudoun Necromancy===
* {{dot|1}} Level 1 {{ref|lvl1}}
** '''Knowing Stone''': By painting a name on a stone with his blood, the Necromancer sees where the soul of a person resides.

* {{dot|3}} Level 3 {{ref|lvl3}}
** '''Blood Dance''': In a ceremony where the Necromancer dances and chants to attract the right spirit.
** '''Eyes of the Dead''': The Necromancer spills vitae over an object associated with a deceased person.
